title: Measuring Item Freshness in Data Streams

problem.claim: The paper studies item freshness in data streams, defined as the time interval between an item's last arrival and the present moment.

gap.claim: There is no algorithm tailored for estimating item freshness.

contributions.claim: The paper proposes RingSketch, a theoretically guaranteed sketch algorithm for real-time freshness measurement that integrates a time-agnostic sketch algorithm with a time-aware CLOCK algorithm.
RingSketch estimates freshness by tracing the trajectory of the clock pointer.
The paper theoretically derives the average error of RingSketch.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report validating RingSketch with extensive experiments.
The authors report that RingSketch achieves less than 10^-3 average relative error and an update speed greater than 11.4 M/s.
The authors report that RingSketch outperforms baseline solutions by at least 13.3x in accuracy and 1.5x in update speed.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper introduces item freshness as an unexplored data-stream attribute and defines it as elapsed time since an item's last arrival.
Freshness information is useful in several scenarios, but no tailored estimation algorithm currently exists.
The paper proposes RingSketch, combining time-agnostic sketching with a time-aware CLOCK algorithm and tracing the clock pointer's trajectory.
The authors derive average error theoretically and report extensive experimental validation with high accuracy, fast updates, and improvements over baselines.
The authors report that all code is open-sourced on GitHub.

source_observation.claim: RingSketch combines a time-agnostic sketch algorithm with a time-aware CLOCK algorithm for real-time freshness measurement.

interpretation.claim: Combining a compact summary structure with an explicit temporal mechanism may support efficient estimation of recency-like properties in streams.

application.claim: This pattern may be applicable to streaming cache management, online advertising, and computer-network monitoring.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether the approach generalizes beyond the reported freshness-measurement setting.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the data-stream model, workload assumptions, or memory complexity.
The abstract does not identify the baseline solutions or experimental datasets.
The abstract does not provide the theoretical error bound or its conditions.
